newsitem.title: UK: Elvis dead? You bet he is.
newsitem.headline: Elvis dead? You bet he is.

text.p: After two decades of taking bets that Elvis Presley is still alive, bookmakers William Hill say fans have finally accepted that the king of rock 'n roll is decomposing rather than composing.
Spokesman Graham Sharpe said the number of fans still convinced that Presley did not die of a heart attack on August 16, 1977, seemed to be dwindling.

"We've pushed the odds on Elvis being proved still to be alive out to 2,000-1 but haven't taken a bet since August last year when a fan staked 100 pounds ($160) on Elvis returning for a live concert," he said.
"Just a few years ago, the odds were as low as 25-1 and we were looking at a potential payout of up to three million pounds if he reappeared."
Those who refuse to accept Presley is dead believe he is living in obscurity or could even be an unwilling guest on board an alien spaceship.
